subject: [RFC PATCH 38/57] mm/collapse: report the round, and what it made faulters wait

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a new event, mm_collapse_round, to report the time it takes for a thread to wait on a source due to batching. The event includes information about the number of candidates collected and installed, as well as the outcome of the collapse operation. This is intended to help evaluate whether larger batches are beneficial by measuring the wait time for faulters. The patch introduces a new field in the trace events and updates the collapse_finish function to return the number of candidates installed.
